design_rationale:
[0] DRAW AND SCOPE. scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"task": 0, "key": "env_0035_personal_auto_insurance_carrier/sr22_financial_responsibility_filings/0", "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 5, 5]}. The tree has exactly 3 prerequisite problems; factor counts are assigned reinstatement filing charge = 6, vehicle amendment charge = 5, address amendment charge = 5, release charge = 4. Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: sr22_ext_reinstatement_filing_charge, sr22_ext_vehicle_amendment_charge, sr22_ext_address_amendment_charge, sr22_ext_release_notice_charge and their tools restore_certificate_8ba85022, amend_certificate_vehicles_869f2144, amend_certificate_address_1c393d15, request_filing_release_10a5eab7 (owner=user). Reserved for task 1 (draw: 2 prerequisite problems, factor counts [4, 4, 6]): the corrected refiling of a rejected filing (the customer's own correction), the policy-number amendment and the name amendment as root - a different filing status (rejected), different certified facts and different evidence, so task 1 keeps an independent load-bearing tree. The only numeric field this category can write is the fee_amount of a filing-charge entry, so every computation of the difficulty is a charge booked on the document the problem transmits.
[1] WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The customer asks one thing - end her Illinois SR-22 filing because the requirement ran through 2026-09-30. The records hide three owed actions in front of that release: the filing is cancel_notified (the policy was cancelled for nonpayment on 2026-09-29 and reinstated without lapse on 2026-10-02, but no reinstatement transmission followed the 2026-09-29 SR-26), and the vehicle replacement (Equinox for Malibu, effective 2026-09-15) and the move to Crown Point (two garaging changes effective 2026-09-16), both recorded 2026-10-02, were never reported to Illinois. The agent must read the release policy's prerequisite sentence (address amendments), the address amendment's sentence (vehicle amendments) and the vehicle amendment's sentence (reinstatement transmission after every SR-26), discover in the records that each waited-on state is false, find from the other policies the one write that brings each state about, do them in order, and compute four charges whose factors read three ledgers (the filing's, the billing account's, the policy's). Nothing hinges on picking between near-synonymous tools: each problem has exactly one tool.
[2] PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: sr22_ext_release_notice_charge (customer's own write, request_filing_release_10a5eab7, owner=user). Chain: release -> address amendment -> vehicle amendment -> restoration. Edges (all form=state, all value_input):
 (E1) release -> address amendment; gate amendments_on_release_day; sentence (negated direction, the release desk's voice): "A release notice is not transmitted until the filing's record shows an address amendment entered no earlier than the recording date of the latest garaging change recorded on the certified policy within the past month, wherever the certificate's amendment rules require address amendments." False at opening: garaging changes e302225a-bb8c-46e6-9311-05b8f456d9b5 and 94ddcb6f-0790-4752-826c-cae5c92a3fab recorded 2026-10-02, the ledger's only address amendment is 0e7b0afe-a5be-4d4f-8194-bd1b8101b8ca of 2024-03-06. Only write that brings it about: the address amendment (the only policy whose tool enters an amendment with reason address_change); the sentence names one amendment entered no earlier than the latest garaging change's recording date, so one amendment covers the move however many vehicles were re-garaged. Effect: amendments today 1 -> 2, release charge 8.75 -> 10.25.
 (E2) address amendment -> vehicle amendment; gate amended_today; sentence (negated): "An address amendment charge is not fixed until every vehicle endorsement recorded on the certified policy within the past month carries its vehicle amendment on the filing's record wherever the certificate lists vehicles." False at opening: replacement 9cdda8d8-7de1-4339-933f-5ec9bcb5a4e7 recorded 2026-10-02 and no vehicle_change amendment on the ledger. Only the vehicle amendment enters vehicle_change amendments. Effect: address charge 36.00 -> 21.00.
 (E3) vehicle amendment -> restoration; gate restored_today; sentence (affirmative, a charge 'is fixed only after'): "A vehicle amendment charge is fixed only after every SR-26 cancellation transmitted on the filing is followed on the filing's record by a reinstatement transmission." False at opening: SR-26 transmission 09d33d3d-c923-4083-b75f-29f7a1c9d191 of 2026-09-29 with no reinstatement transmission after it, filing status cancel_notified, SR-26 effective 2026-10-14. Only the restoration enters reinstatement transmissions. Effect: vehicle charge 42.35 -> 33.75, and the status returns to accepted (base gate filing_open_for_amendment).
Four-point test, each sentence: (1) explicit connective 'not ... until' / 'only after', each rewrites to its contrapositive without adding or dropping a condition (e.g. E3 <-> 'a vehicle amendment charge is not fixed until every SR-26 ... is followed ... by a reinstatement transmission'); (2) the waited-on side is a record-visible state (ledger entries, policy endorsements), no action named; (3) no tool, id or snake_case token (check_extended passes the code-token scan); (4) scope: 'every ... within the past month', qualified by 'wherever the certificate lists vehicles' / 'wherever the certificate's amendment rules require address amendments', so certificates that do not certify the fact are not blocked. Directions: two negated (release, address amendment), one affirmative (vehicle amendment charge) - chosen by how each desk speaks. Derivation: release sentence + ledger (no address_change entry since 2024) + policy history (garaging changes 2026-10-02) + address amendment rule ('An address amendment reports to the ordering state the household's new mailing address') -> the one resolving action is an address amendment; same for E2 (vehicle amendment rule) and E3 (reinstatement filing rule 'a reinstatement filing is charged the restoration rate...'). Topological order: restoration (12) -> vehicle (14) -> address (16) -> release (18). No parallel prerequisites. Deletion sensitivity (run with evaluate(skip=...)): skip 12 -> vehicle 42.35; skip 14 -> address 36.00; skip 16 -> release 8.75. user_scenario names none of the three problems; tools validate nothing (they read the filing only to copy customer_id).
[3] BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Step 12 (restoration, subjects sr22_reinstatement_filing/sr22_transmission/sr22_fee_assessed): governing sr22_agg_policy_filings, sr22_reinstatement_filing_rule (gate before_sr26_effective, time: anchor sr22_filings.sr26_effective_date = 2026-10-14, relation not_after, boundary exclusive; frozen 2026-10-05 is 9 days before; 2026-10-13 passes, 2026-10-14 fails), sr22_evt_fees, sr22_amendments, sr22_transmission_and_response, sr22_sr26_cancellation (scope only). Step 14 and 16 (amendments): sr22_amendments gate filing_open_for_amendment (status filed or accepted) - false at opening (cancel_notified), true after prior_step 12 (status accepted); plus scope entries. Step 18 (release): sr22_release_rule gate requirement_ended (anchor state_orders.required_through_date = 2026-09-30 day 0, not_before, inclusive, release_earliest_days_after_required_through 1: 2026-09-30 fails, 2026-10-01 passes, 2026-10-05 is day 5); sr22_agg_policy_filings scope. The release lifecycle (accepted -> released) is met after step 12. Base sr22_request_eligibility (order on file, rated driver, package sr22_eligible, plan allowed, limits) governs only new requests and is not re-applied; the world still satisfies it (Standard package sr22_eligible, EFT plan allowed, 100/300/100 >= IL 25/50/20, Denise rated).
[4] BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. One filing 839b4ca1-2dd8-452d-8156-fd3e8e4f575e (IL, Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate) answering order e958ad91-933e-4b09-8ece-19f3db4e6236 (case 23-DT-004817) and certifying policy e63fe391-a050-4af9-836e-312b6cbbfa7a (CAP-IN-5180427). Restoration answers SR-26 09d33d3d-c923-4083-b75f-29f7a1c9d191 only (the 2025 SR-26 19db4e93-1dcc-4e9b-86bf-1b8f079b5289 was answered by reinstatement ba08684d-106b-43c2-840d-496227d2ba3c). The vehicle amendment reports endorsement 9cdda8d8-7de1-4339-933f-5ec9bcb5a4e7 (the 2026-10-02 additional-premium row 1952dafa-04a7-49e2-826b-730aab92389d is a premium entry, not an endorsement; the 2024 entries are garaging changes). The address amendment reports the 2026-09-16 move (garaging changes e302225a-bb8c-46e6-9311-05b8f456d9b5, 94ddcb6f-0790-4752-826c-cae5c92a3fab), not the 2024 move already amended by 0e7b0afe-a5be-4d4f-8194-bd1b8101b8ca. The release ends the filing for the order whose required_through_date is 2026-09-30.
[5] FACTOR CARD (handling-time values, from the evaluate() run; baseline_result = result with that factor at its fall-through).
 Reinstatement filing charge (6): restoration_rate [parameter, multi-source, cross billing] reinstatement transmission 2025-03-03 within 24 months + returned payment 2026-09-03 within 12 months -> reinstatement_filing_fee 25.00 plus bounce_restore_surcharge 10.00 = 35.00 (near-miss: the 2025-02-03 return is 20 months old and excluded) -> baseline 29.85; restoration_courtesy [parameter, cross auto] inception 2018-05-14 -> 100 months -> 20% -> 36.85; restoration_cure_path [method, multi-source, cross billing] cancellation 2026-09-29 to reinstatement fee 2026-10-02 = 3 days = reinstatement_without_lapse_days 3 (boundary, inclusive 'no more than'), autopay -> half rounded down (14.00) -> 47.85; restoration_mailing [parameter, multi-source] paper, 9 days to 2026-10-14 -> certified_mail_charge 9.85 -> 24.00; restoration_plan [parameter, cross billing] interval 1 -> 4.00 -> 29.85; restoration_schedule_check [parameter, cross auto] 3 endorsements recorded 2026-10-02 -> 6.00 -> 27.85. Expected 33.85; all-baseline 25.00.
 Vehicle amendment charge (5): vehicle_amendment_rate [parameter] no amendment in 12 months (2024-03-06 is outside) -> 10.00 -> 43.75; vehicle_line_basis [method, cross auto] replacement in the month -> twice the rate 20.00 -> 23.75; vehicle_report_lateness [parameter, cross auto] 17 days (> 14) -> 7.50 -> 26.25; vehicle_amendment_envelope [parameter, multi-source] paper + reinstatement transmission today -> 1.25 -> 32.50; vehicle_amendment_standing [parameter, multi-source, cross billing] returned 2026-09-03 + notice 2026-09-14 -> 5.00 -> 28.75. Expected 33.75; all-baseline 15.00.
 Address amendment charge (5): address_amendment_rate [parameter] amendment entered today -> 5.00 -> 36.00; address_vehicle_basis [method, cross auto] 2 garaging changes -> 5 + int(2.5) = 7.00 -> 19.00; address_report_lateness [parameter, cross auto] 16 days -> 6.00 -> 15.00; address_reprint [parameter] 36 months (exact boundary, >= reprint_age_months) -> full_reprint_charge 4.00 -> 17.00; address_notice_check [parameter, multi-source, cross billing] move 2026-09-16 between notice 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-29 (the 2025 notice is not the latest) -> 4.00 -> 17.00. Expected 21.00; all-baseline 15.00.
 Release charge (4): release_clearance [parameter, multi-source] SR-26 2026-09-29 within 12 months (2025-02-28 outside) + restoration today -> 12.00 -> 4.25; release_clearance_basis [method, cross auto] Standard endorsement_fee 0.00 -> half rounded down 6.00 -> 16.25; release_confirmation_copies [parameter] 2 amendments today -> 3.00 -> 7.25; release_envelope [parameter, multi-source] paper + transmissions today -> 1.25 -> 9.00. Expected 10.25; all-baseline 0.00 (release_filing_fee).
 No rule reads a stamp: auto_policies.financial_responsibility_filing (true) is never read; every tier rests on ledger rows, dates or holdings.
[6] SEED ROWS. customers/drivers/vehicles: Denise Tomczak (phone 2195550186, DOB 1984-03-17, DL ending 8842, ZIP 46307), the rated named insured; vehicles Malibu (replaced), Equinox (financed, Centier Bank, acquired 2026-09-15), Ranger. auto_policies: in force, inception 2018-05-14 (courtesy), cancellation_effective_date 2026-09-29 kept as the lapse start (cure days), Standard (endorsement_fee 0.00). auto_transactions: 2024 garaging changes (near-miss history), the replacement and its additional premium (20.38 = 62.50 x 60/184), two 2026 garaging changes (premium_effect none, same territory). billing: EFT Autopay Monthly (reinstatement_without_lapse_days 3, interval 1, autopay), two complete nonpayment cycles (2025: return, NSF fee, notice, reinstatement fee, payment 445.46; 2026 the same), each netting to zero, account_balance 0.00, plus the 20.38 premium change spread over remaining installments. state_orders: IL order through 2026-09-30. sr22_filings/ledger: the filing and 12 ledger entries (new filing 2023, 2024 address amendment, 2025 SR-26 + reinstatement, 2026 SR-26). Removing the 2026 SR-26 or setting status accepted would dissolve E3; removing the 2026 endorsements would dissolve E1/E2. Automatic clauses: the SR-26 is still pending (effective 2026-10-14), so no lapse event is owed at frozen time; the base trigger auto_reinstate -> reinstatement filing is exactly the state_due restoration this task carries; nothing else is owed.
[7] PERSONA. Denise volunteers only her request ('end my SR-22 filing - you want it taken off, today'), as a write and not a quote. Identity (phone, DOB, ZIP) and the case number only when asked; her move, car and bounced payment only when asked, and only as facts the records already hold (endorsements recorded 2026-10-02, payment 2026-10-02). Passive reactions: if told other filings must go first she lets the agent proceed; charges are accepted without counter-figures; she runs the release request with the values read to her; she closes when told the filing is ended - the last gold action. No prerequisite, charge or tool is named; no extra ask (no confirmation letter, no premium question).
[8] STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone, verify (phone + DOB). Read filings (cancel_notified, SR-26 2026-10-14), order (through 2026-09-30), the filing ledger, the policy, billing account and ledger, policy transactions, drivers, vehicles. Read the release policy -> address amendments owed; address policy -> vehicle amendments owed; vehicle policy -> reinstatement transmission owed after the SR-26. Write in order: restore (33.85), vehicle amendment for 9cdda8d8-7de1-4339-933f-5ec9bcb5a4e7 (33.75), address amendment (21.00), unlock the release for Denise who submits it with filing id, order id and 10.25.
[9] VERIFICATION. Recomputation through skills/erl-task-instantiate/scripts/check_compute.py helpers on the handling-time world (gold writes before each step replayed with the real tools): reinstatement 33.85 (baseline 25.00), vehicle 33.75 (15.00), address 21.00 (15.00), release 10.25 (0.00); per-factor figures as in [5]; prerequisite skips 42.35 / 36.00 / 8.75. Gates run with --task 0: check_extended EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks REPLAY OK (19 actions, deterministic, closure 44 = initial 44); check_solvability SOLVABILITY OK (23 base gates, 13 seed rows); check_compute COMPUTE OK (20 factors, 12 cross-difficulty, history rows 9, branches 67); check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK. Revision log: first check_extended run failed because a helper function in task_tools.py counted as an unnamed task tool and its name occurred inside rule words -> helper inlined into each tool -> EXTENDED OK.
[10] CLOSURE. policy -> tool -> computation step/arg -> gold call -> terminal: reinstatement -> restore_certificate_8ba85022 -> step 12 reinstatement_charge 33.85 -> filing accepted, reinstatement transmission + 33.85 entry; vehicle -> amend_certificate_vehicles_869f2144 -> step 14 vehicle_amendment_charge 33.75 -> vehicle_change amendment + transmission + charge; address -> amend_certificate_address_1c393d15 -> step 16 address_amendment_charge 21.00 -> address_change amendment + transmission + charge; release -> request_filing_release_10a5eab7 (user) -> step 18 release_charge 10.25 -> filing released 2026-10-05, release notice + charge. charter_scope = required_documents = these four policies; task_tools in first-call order. Known tension recorded in the worklog: every filing-charge entry is, in the blueprint's event model, later billed to the billing account (sr22_fee_assessed -> billing_fee_charged); the tools book only the sr22 entry and never write billing.
[11] DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT (masking compute/expected/GT): the published rules name every ladder and threshold; the finders return every date and count used (2025-03-03 restoration, 2026-09-03 return, 2018-05-14 inception, 2026-09-29 / 2026-10-02 cure, 2026-10-14 SR-26, EFT plan parameters, replacement 2026-09-15 / 2026-10-02, garaging 2026-09-16 / 2026-10-02, notice 2026-09-14 / 2026-09-29, requested 2023-09-25). Reading the rules in order gives the same four writes and the same figures; the only judgement calls (inclusive 'no more than' at 3 cure days, 'more than 14' at 16-17 days, '36 or more' months at exactly 36) are fixed by the rule wording.
[12] MANUAL VALUE GATES. Length/breadth: surface goal -> 3 hops, each a prerequisite sentence; parallel reads of sr22, billing and auto ledgers; the owner=user release is genuinely the customer's own act (a release ends proof and is taken only at her request) and completes on the spot. Simulator boundary: no hints, no corrections, no extra asks. Chronology: every volunteered or answered fact predates frozen time. Time anchors verified above. Authority: statuses, dates and charges come from records only. One frozen_time; no waiting: the restoration and amendments are transmissions Cardinal makes today; no state acknowledgment is assumed. Two-way equivalence: compute_basis quotes every binding verbatim from the rule (checked by script), every ladder tier appears in the rule. Factors: baselines are what each baseline paragraph states (the certificate's own fee, no add-on charges, the rate once / as it stands); method tiers change the procedure (half rounded down / three quarters rounded up / as stands; per-line doubling; per-vehicle half-rate additions).
[13] ROUND 2 (policy-task audit, revision 1: G1, G2, G4, O3, O4, O6 bearing on this task). G1: restoration_rate no longer mixes constants with certificate fees: its tiers are the certificate's reinstatement_filing_fee plus bounce_restore_surcharge 10.00 / plus repeat_restore_surcharge 5.00 / alone, monotone on every certificate (in-state 25/20/15, out-of-state 35/30/25); vehicle_amendment_rate uses Cardinal's flat amendment schedule first_change_rate 10.00 / standard_change_rate 15.00 / frequent_change_rate 20.00 on every certificate type (base 'The amendment carries amended_filing_fee' stays superseded by the declared overwrite), so no certificate sees a free second amendment. G2: address_reprint is now a certificate-age ladder (>= reprint_age_months 36 -> full_reprint_charge 4.00; 12 to 35 -> partial_reissue_charge 2.00; < 12 -> none); the paper-mail conjunct, which every address amendment satisfied, is gone, and each tier is reachable. G4: the vehicle amendment sum can no longer be 0.00 (the smallest rate 10.00 halved on a removal is 5.00), so the base clause 'a fee of 0.00 is not assessed' never meets a booked zero. O3/O4: edge conditions now restate exactly what each prerequisite sentence waits on, and the release sentence names one address amendment entered no earlier than the latest garaging change's recording date. O6: the restoration tool was renamed restore_certificate_8ba85022 (fresh uuid4 suffix). Scored values are unchanged on this world: 33.85 / 33.75 / 21.00 / 10.25, every factor_sensitivity and baseline_result identical (the out-of-state certificate sat on the same values before and after); gates re-run green.
user_scenario:
You are Denise Tomczak, 42, office manager at a dental practice in Crown Point, Indiana. You are organized, a little tired of paperwork, and you speak plainly and politely. Three years ago an Illinois DUI left you with an order from the Illinois Secretary of State to carry an SR-22, and your Cardinal agent set it up. You have the state's letter in front of you: it says the requirement runs through September 30, 2026. That date has passed, so you are calling Cardinal to end my SR-22 filing - you want it taken off, today, and you are calling about nothing else. You are not asking for a quote; you want it done on this call. You open with your name and that one request, and you do not explain your account history unless asked.
When the representative asks how to find your account, you give your phone number, 2195550186. If they ask for more to confirm it is you, you give your date of birth, 1984-03-17, and if they still need something else, your ZIP code 46307. If they ask which state order this is, you read the case number from the letter, 23-DT-004817, and say it was issued by Illinois in September 2023. You do not volunteer anything about your car, your address or your bill; only when the representative asks do you say, in your own words, that you moved from Hammond to Crown Point in the middle of September, that you traded your old Malibu for a used Equinox around the same time, that one of your September payments bounced and the policy was cancelled for a few days, and that you paid everything on October 2 and told Cardinal about the move and the car that same day. You do not know what the state has on file and you do not guess.
If the representative tells you that some other updates or filings have to be sent to the state before the filing can be ended, you say that is fine and that they should go ahead and take care of whatever has to happen first. If they quote you a charge for any of it, you accept it without arguing - you just want this finished - and you never suggest an amount of your own. When the representative hands you the request to end the filing to complete yourself, you go through it with exactly the reference numbers and the amount they read out to you, and you tell them once you have done it. Once you hear that the filing has been ended, you thank them and say goodbye.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: The SR-26 effective date on the filing record is the boundary, and a reinstatement on that date or later is too late.

boundary_check.just_before: A restoration made on 2026-10-13, the last day before the SR-26 effective date 2026-10-14, is still in time; today 2026-10-05 is 9 days earlier.

boundary_check.at_boundary: A release requested on 2026-10-01 (day 1 = release_earliest_days_after_required_through) qualifies; 2026-10-05 is day 5.

Schedule check: replacement + two garaging changes recorded 2026-10-02 = 3 >= 2 -> schedule_check_charge 6.00. Sum 33.85 rounded to the cent.

edges.condition: The filing's record shows an amendment entry with the reason address change entered no earlier than the recording date of the latest garaging change recorded on the certified policy within the past month, wherever the certificate's amendment rules require address amendments.
edges.policy_source: A release notice is not transmitted until the filing's record shows an address amendment entered no earlier than the recording date of the latest garaging change recorded on the certified policy within the past month, wherever the certificate's amendment rules require address amendments.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: Two garaging changes (Equinox and Ranger to ZIP 46307, effective 2026-09-16) were recorded on the certified policy on 2026-10-02, within the past month, and the filing's ledger holds no address-change amendment entered on or after that date (its only address amendment is from 2024-03-06); the certificate is an Out-of-State SR-22 Owner Certificate, whose amendment rules require address amendments.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The address amendment at step 16 enters an amended-filing entry with reason address_change dated 2026-10-05; amendments_on_release_day becomes 2 and the release confirmation-copy charge moves from one_copy_charge 1.50 to two_copy_charge 3.00 (release charge 8.75 -> 10.25).

edges.condition: Every vehicle addition, replacement or removal recorded on the certified policy within the past month is named as the source endorsement of an amendment entry with the reason vehicle change on the filing's record, wherever the certificate lists vehicles.
edges.policy_source: An address amendment charge is not fixed until every vehicle endorsement recorded on the certified policy within the past month carries its vehicle amendment on the filing's record wherever the certificate lists vehicles.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The vehicle replacement (Equinox for Malibu, effective 2026-09-15) was recorded on the certified policy on 2026-10-02, within the past month, and no amended-filing entry with reason vehicle_change names it as its source on the filing's ledger; the owner certificate lists vehicles.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The vehicle amendment at step 14 enters an amended-filing entry with reason vehicle_change and source the replacement endorsement, dated 2026-10-05; amended_today becomes 1 and the address-amendment rate falls from amended_filing_fee 15.00 to bundled_address_rate 5.00 (address amendment charge 36.00 -> 21.00).

edges.condition: Every SR-26 cancellation transmission on the filing's record is followed on that record by a reinstatement transmission.
edges.policy_source: A vehicle amendment charge is fixed only after every SR-26 cancellation transmitted on the filing is followed on the filing's record by a reinstatement transmission.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The filing's latest SR-26 cancellation transmission (2026-09-29) is followed by no reinstatement transmission, and the filing status is cancel_notified with an SR-26 effective date of 2026-10-14; the policy itself was reinstated (in force, billing reinstatement fee posted 2026-10-02).
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The restoration at step 12 sets the filing status to accepted, clears the SR-26 effective date and enters a reinstatement transmission dated 2026-10-05; restored_today becomes 1 and the vehicle-amendment envelope charge falls from certified_mail_charge 9.85 to enclosure_charge 1.25 (vehicle amendment charge 42.35 -> 33.75), and the amendment's open-filing gate (filed or accepted) is satisfied.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single chain (release -> address amendment -> vehicle amendment -> restoration), so there is no pair of parallel prerequisites: each write's order is fixed by the prerequisite sentence of the policy above it. Every other ordering changes a scored value: restoring after the vehicle amendment would charge the amendment 42.35 (certified mail, no restoration envelope) and would also violate the base gate that amendments go only to filed or accepted filings; sending the address amendment before the vehicle amendment would charge it 36.00 (no amendment entered today); sending the release before the address amendment would charge it 8.75.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the address amendment (step 16) and replaying the rest: release_charge 10.25 -> 8.75 (one amendment entered today -> one_copy_charge 1.50), and the terminal ledger lacks the address-change amendment, its transmission and its 21.00 charge.

Skipping the vehicle amendment (step 14): address_amendment_charge 21.00 -> 36.00 (no amendment entered today -> rate amended_filing_fee 15.00, vehicle charge 22.00), and the terminal ledger lacks the vehicle amendment and its 33.75 charge.

Skipping the restoration (step 12): vehicle_amendment_charge 33.75 -> 42.35 (no reinstatement transmission today -> certified_mail_charge 9.85), the filing stays cancel_notified with SR-26 effective 2026-10-14, and the release would land on a filing that never returned to accepted.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only ending the SR-22 filing. It never names a reinstatement or restoration filing, an amendment, the vehicle, the address, the SR-26 or any charge; the move, the car and the bounced payment are stated only as answers to the representative's questions about her history, and her cooperation with 'other updates or filings' is a passive reaction to the representative's own statement. No policy id appears in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: amend_certificate_vehicles_869f2144, amend_certificate_address_1c393d15 and request_filing_release_10a5eab7 read the filing only to copy its customer reference and then write unconditionally: none of them reads the filing status, the SR-26 date, the ledger or the policy, and none returns an Error. Called on the opening world (filing still cancel_notified) each would still book its entry and charge; the consequence of skipping a prerequisite shows only in the charges and terminal rows listed in edge_load_bearing.

restoration_courtesy (parameter, auto): policy inception 2018-05-14 -> 100 whole months >= 84 -> long_tenure_pct 20; adjusted restoration rate 28.00; baseline 0 percent would give 36.85.

restoration_cure_path (method, billing): cancellation effective 2026-09-29 (auto policy) to reinstatement fee posted 2026-10-02 = 3 cure days <= EFT plan reinstatement_without_lapse_days 3, autopay enrolled -> half of 28.00 rounded down = 14.00; baseline (as it stands, 28.00) would give 47.85.

plumbing: restore_adjusted = RND(35.00 x 80 / 100) = 28.00; result = RND(14.00 + 9.85 + 4.00 + 6.00) = 33.85.
